sections.detail: Clark Canyon Dam: The Bureau of Reclamation documents a Beaverhead River launch below the dam, but the catalog label and available agency coordinates identify the dam or recreation area rather than the exact river-side launch.

Barretts Station Park (above dam): Boating access at the park is documented, but the Visit Montana coordinate is within about 31 metres of the USBR diversion-dam coordinate. It is not a dependable park/landing marker and was rejected on 2026-10-28. Need a source locating the take-out upstream of the dam.

The exact Caras Park landing has not been confirmed. The city documents Silver Park as a downtown take-out, but that is a different endpoint and this listing has not yet been revised or remeasured.

Do not use this listing to plan a casual float. Missoula identifies Silver Park as the last public exit before the downstream Grass Valley diversion dam, with Kelly Island below the dam. A suitable route and access plan have not been established.
An exact legal take-out at Edgar has not been established for this listing. A town or bridge name is not enough to plan an exit.

The 2015 access survey distinguishes Greek Creek Campground from its upstream pull-out, and Upper Storm Castle from Lower Storm Castle. Greek Creek’s bank was rebuilt in 2024–2025; the current designated raft launch must be reconciled with those older points before mapping this trip.

Shedd's Bridge: The official FWP access guide marks this site closed for public safety due to an unstable river bank, and it is absent from the current managed-access inventory. Do not use it as a take-out without current agency confirmation.
